# SOrT — Stash Or Trash | The Brand Barometer

> SOrT (Stash Or Trash) is the live Consumer Experience (CX) & Public Accountability Brand Barometer where real customers cast receipt- and scan-backed verdicts on brands worldwide.

## Core Services & Features
- **Brand Barometer**: Real-time crowd-sourced customer trust ratings and Moody's-grade trust trajectories across retail, hospitality, financial, automotive, tech, and FMCG brands.
- **Stash vs Trash Verdicts**: Consumers vote "Stash" (commendation) or "Trash" (constructive accountability callout) backed by proof.
- **AI Authenticity & Barcode Scanner**: Barcode, SKU, batch, and optical packaging inspection to catch counterfeits and trace parent corporate ownership.
- **Corporate Brand Command Suite**: Domain-verified corporate teams collaborate directly with customers, manage shift operators, and resolve escalations within SLA windows.
- **Awards & Milestones**: Recognition for verified brands maintaining high customer trust factors.
